content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Crypto payment gateways like NOWPayments and CoinGate offer APIs to accept 300+ cryptocurrencies. They solve payment collection but require you to host your own store, handle file delivery, and manage orders. This is a partial solution. Hosted platforms like Selar and Paystack clone Stripe’s model but limit you to their infrastructure. They charge 2-5% per transaction and retain control over your data. Sovereign commerce stacks like COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploy your own store, payment processor, and file delivery system. You own the code, data, and infrastructure. No platform lock-in. No recurring fees. This is base-layer architecture, not a workaround.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Crypto payment gateways do not exclude countries—they exclude fiat currencies. If your buyers cannot access crypto, this option fails. Hosted platforms like Selar and Paystack operate within Nigeria but are still subject to local banking restrictions. They solve part of the problem but not the core issue of sovereignty. Sovereign commerce stacks bypass geographic restrictions entirely. Your store runs on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare, payments process on-chain, and files deliver via Google Drive or R2. No single point of failure. No reliance on local or global financial systems. This is infrastructure built for regions where payment rejection is the norm.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Crypto payments confirm in minutes, but network fees vary. BSC, Solana, and TRON cost under $0.10 per transaction. NOWPayments charges 0.5% on top. Hosted platforms charge 2-5% per transaction plus local bank fees. Sovereign stacks have no platform fees after deployment. Your only costs are network fees and optional upgrades. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email deliverability—critical for order confirmations. This is not the cheapest option upfront, but it is the lowest-cost architecture over time.
Sovereign commerce stacks are not workarounds—they are structural replacements.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With crypto gateways, you own your payments but not your infrastructure. Hosted platforms own your data, store, and delivery system. Sovereign stacks give you full ownership. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and R2 for file delivery. Payments automate via webhooks. Orders trigger instant file delivery. You own the code and can modify it. This is not a service—it is a handover of infrastructure. COREMERCH has no access after deployment. You are not renting. You are owning.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If your buyers cannot access crypto, hosted platforms are your only immediate option. If you want to escape platform lock-in, sovereign commerce stacks are the only structural solution. The Edge Commerce Stack is for creators who sell digital products and need full ownership. It is not for beginners—it requires understanding of GitHub, Cloudflare, and basic backend logic. If you are building a business that outlasts payment restrictions, this is your architecture. It is not a workaround. It is a permanent alternative.

It includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments integration. Your store is live in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded and end-to-end testing. Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Edge Commerce Stack for full ownership, crypto gateways for partial solutions. 2. Deploy your store: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting. 3. Set up backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Configure order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets. 5. Integrate payments: NOWPayments for crypto processing. 6. Automate file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test end-to-end: Ensure payments trigger file delivery. 8. Launch: Your store is live, and you own the infrastructure.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use the Edge Commerce Stack if I’m not technical?

The Edge Commerce Stack requires basic understanding of GitHub, Cloudflare, and backend logic. If you are not technical, consider hiring a developer or starting with the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) for documentation.
What cryptocurrencies should I accept?
Accept BSC, Solana, and TRON for low network fees under $0.10 per transaction. Add Bitcoin or Ethereum if your buyers prefer them, but expect higher fees.
Do I need to host my own files?
No. The Edge Commerce Stack uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. You upload files once, and the system handles delivery automatically.
Can I modify the code after deployment?
Yes. You own the code and can modify it. The stack includes full source code and documentation for customization.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is a payment processor, not your infrastructure. If it fails, you can replace it with another crypto gateway without affecting your store or file delivery.
